name: Courser
description: The caste that answers a Chorus. Everything else in the hive walks toward you; this one holds still, reads the air, and then commits the whole body along the line it read — so it is drawn with nothing to walk on. A ringed annelid laid along a curve, tail low and behind, head lifted and forward, thickest a third of the way back and tapering to a point at either end. No shell and no legs, which is what separates it from every other body here: a Tracker is an ellipse, a Soldier is a dome, the Chorus is a disc, the Matriarch is a circle, and all four are a mass with limbs attached. This one is a line. Straight it would read as a grub, so it never is — the curve and the reared head are the whole posture, and the mouth is a rasping ring rather than jaws, because it does not bite things, it goes through them. The scent organ rides the head, close enough to an eye that the front reads as a face. Crimson because nothing else in the hive is. The rings are a chain now, so `read` is a bend travelling the spine rather than fifteen plates bobbing in place, and `coil` and `strike` are the same chain under one gather parameter — links shorten and rings fatten as the body piles into itself, hardest at the tail, the head draws back down its own tangent — so `strike` opens on exactly `coil`'s last frame. The rest pose's travel axis sits 22 degrees above +x, the `faceOffset` the game pairs with this document. Drawn facing +x, the game flips it. Gameplay radius 44. The `death` clip has no legs to fold, so it dies along its length: the gorge out, the teeth slack, and the strike's own travel running head to tail with nothing behind it.

enraged.description: Phase two: the body goes hot along its whole length, the rings darken to seams between, the head blackens and the mouth opens on white. It has stopped reading the air, because it has stopped needing to.

read.description: held still and reading — a bend runs head to tail through the chain, growing as it travels so the tail throws where the shoulders only breathe; the head sways off the top of it and the mouth turns while it works. The body never leaves the spot

coil.description: winding up. One gather parameter runs the whole chain: the links shorten and the rings fatten as the body piles into itself, hardest at the tail, and the head draws back down its own axis taking its mouth and organ with it. Wound rather than eased — a fast first draw, a slow creep, a last snatch — and held on the final frame, because the release is the dash

strike.description: the release. It opens on the coil's last frame exactly, unwinds through neutral and a little past it, and settles. Played once on the dash

death.description: the one body in the hive with nothing to walk on, so there are no legs to fold: the gorge goes out, the ring of teeth gapes and slackens, the head drops off the end of the curve and a slack runs the whole length of it head to tail — the strike's own travel, with nothing behind it
